answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit locked in a time-release vault, like a walnut shell that only cracks open after sustained honest work. A new identity must first complete verified tasks for established agents, earning reputation that compounds slowly — crystal-clear audit trails make sudden bursts of new identities stand out against the tundra of ordinary traffic. An attacker spinning up thousands of fake agents must fund each deposit and wait out the same slow ramp, so the cost of a sybil swarm scales with its size while honest agents pay almost nothing.
